title: Can Large Language Models Beat Wall Street? Unveiling the Potential of AI in Stock Selection

task.value: Selecting stocks (buy/hold/sell signals with explanations) using GPT-4 reasoning over news, fundamentals, price dynamics and macroeconomic data.
task.quote: This paper introduces MarketSenseAI, an innovative framework leveraging GPT-4’s advanced reasoning for selecting stocks in financial markets.

architecture.value: Four GPT-4 summarizer components (progressive news, fundamentals, stock price dynamics with MPNet-identified peers, macro MarketDigest) feed a signal-generation component using Chain of Thought and in-context learning; optional GPT-4 ranking of buy explanations.
architecture.quote: MarketSenseAI’s architectural framework, depicted in Figure 1, merges four core components responsible for data inputs with a fifth component to facilitate the final recommendation (i.e., buy, hold, or sell).

data.value: S&P 100 stocks; EODHD news (163,483 articles) and quarterly fundamentals, daily adjusted close prices, stock descriptions, 187 macro investment reports; monthly signals.
data.quote: News: A total of 163,483 articles published from December 1, 2022, to February 29, 2024, averaging 4.57 articles per day per stock, with a standard deviation of 5.49.

window.value: Assessment period December 1, 2022 to March 31, 2024; 15 months of monthly signals for 100 stocks, held one month after each month-end signal. No train/validation split described.
window.quote: The assessment period spans from December 1, 2022, to March 31, 2024.

models.value: GPT-4 via OpenAI API for all components and ranking; mpnet-base-v2 for stock-similarity embeddings.
models.quote: Each component is built upon OpenAI’s API and employs the GPT-4 model (OpenAI, 2023a), utilizing zero-shot prompting and in-context learning to execute distinct tasks (Dong et al., 2022).

baselines.value: 10,000 bootstrapped random signal portfolios; equally weighted S&P 100; cap-weighted S&P 100 (OEF ETF); Naive 200-day moving average trend strategy; Naive-Top10 by Sharpe; MS-Top10-SR.
baselines.quote: After an iterative examination, we settled on creating 10,000 random portfolios for bootstrapping, observing that additional samples did not significantly alter the evaluation outcomes.

headline_result.value: MS-Top10-Cap-GPT total return 72.87% (71.64% after costs), Sharpe 2.80, over the evaluation period; vs S&P100 43.27%. MS equal-weight 35.48% vs S&P100-Eq 25.22%.

costs.value: Transaction costs of 5bps per trade applied; returns after costs reported in parentheses.
costs.quote: Values in parenthesis represent the total returns after transaction costs (5bps/trade).

uncertainty.value: Bootstrapping against 10,000 random signal portfolios; reports quantiles of MarketSenseAI's cumulative return and hit ratio in bootstrapped distribution (e.g., Buy: R quantile 98.70, HR quantile 99.35). No repeated LLM runs reported.
uncertainty.quote: In this study, bootstrapping was employed to evaluate MarketSenseAI’s performance and its statistical significance against randomized investment signals.

leakage_controls.value: Signal generation fed at each month end only with the latest available summaries, with fundamentals updated only when a new quarterly report became available; evaluated on the following month's returns. No discussion of GPT-4 training-data contamination.
leakage_controls.quote: To evaluate the system, the "Signal Generation" component was fed at the end of each month with the latest available summaries (news, fundamentals, price dynamics, macro).

limitations.value: Assumptions about investment decision factors, uncertain GPT-4 effectiveness in other markets, and limited study duration requiring extended research across market conditions.
limitations.quote: However, it’s crucial to acknowledge the study’s limitations, including the assumptions made about investment decision factors and GPT-4’s effectiveness in different markets. The limited duration of the study also highlights the need for extended research

release.value: No code/data release stated; MarketSenseAI is available as a commercial service at https://www.marketsense-ai.com/.
